Most small and growing businesses run on a patchwork of tools. Leads arrive in one place, WhatsApp chats live on someone's phone, attendance is in a register, salaries are in a spreadsheet and expenses are scattered across bank statements. Every handover between these tools is a chance to lose a customer or make a mistake.

XRover CRM was built to replace that patchwork with one system. It started as the software we use to run our own sales team, and it now covers the full day-to-day operation of a business: leads, sales, customer communication, HR and accounts.

Why one system instead of five tools

When every team member works in the same system, three things get easier:

  • Nothing falls between the cracks. A lead from an ad, a WhatsApp message, a follow-up reminder and a payment all sit on the same customer record.
  • Managers see the real picture. Who is present today, who has which leads, which customers are waiting for a reply and how the month is going are all visible in one place.
  • Less copying, fewer errors. Data is entered once and used everywhere: in reports, in salary calculations and in customer reminders.

Lead management

XRover CRM collects leads automatically from the channels where businesses actually advertise:

  • Meta lead ads on Facebook and Instagram
  • Click-to-WhatsApp ads
  • YouTube lead forms and WhatsApp links from your videos
  • Enquiry forms on your own websites

New leads are shared out to the sales team automatically. Distribution follows attendance, so only staff who are present receive leads, and leads that an absent staff member has not touched are passed to someone who is working. During office hours, unattended leads are reassigned so that no enquiry waits too long. Every lead keeps its full history: stage, notes, reminders, messages and calls.

WhatsApp Business API built in

For many customers, WhatsApp is the first and only channel they use. XRover CRM connects to the official WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) from Meta, so the whole team can work from one business number inside the CRM instead of passing a single phone around.

Voice chat and voice calls

Some customers prefer to talk. Your team can exchange WhatsApp voice messages and make WhatsApp voice calls from inside the CRM, and the conversation stays attached to the customer's record.

Automated follow-ups

Follow-ups are where most sales are won or lost. XRover CRM schedules WhatsApp follow-ups and reminders automatically, sends welcome messages to new customers, and reminds customers before a renewal or expiry date. Your staff spend their time on conversations that need a person, not on remembering who to message next.

Chatbot until your team steps in

When a new lead messages you, the chatbot replies instantly with buttons and AI-assisted answers, lets the customer choose a language, and can share payment links. As soon as a staff member takes over, the bot steps back.

HR management

  • Attendance with face scan and location. Staff mark attendance from their phone. The location is visible only to admins and managers.
  • Salary plans, targets and incentives. Define basic salary plans linked to targets, plus incentives for new sales and renewals, and let the CRM calculate them from real data.
  • Roles and permissions. Admins, managers and staff each see what they need, and sensitive data stays restricted.
  • Performance dashboards. See leads handled, conversions and follow-ups per person.

Accounts management

XRover CRM records income, expenses and payments in the same place as the sales that produced them. It supports payment links and payment-proof approvals, keeps partner and investment records for owners, and produces monthly summaries. Owners and admins get reports without rebuilding spreadsheets every month.

Customer app and shared inbox

Customers can have their own portal with in-app videos, automatic renewal reminders, in-app chat and free browser voice calls with their contact person. On the business side, company email inboxes can be read and answered inside the CRM, with admin-only visibility where needed.

Who XRover CRM is for

XRover CRM suits businesses that sell through ads and WhatsApp and run a sales or support team: training institutes, service businesses, subscription businesses, clinics, agencies and similar teams. Because we build it ourselves, it can also be adapted to a company's own process.

If your leads, chats, staff and accounts are spread across too many tools, XRover CRM brings them together in one place.

Frequently asked questions

What is XRover CRM?

XRover CRM is business software from XRover Tech that combines lead management, WhatsApp Business API messaging and calls, automated follow-ups, HR management and accounts in one system.

Does XRover CRM use the official WhatsApp Business API?

Yes. It connects to Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), so your team can message, send voice notes and make WhatsApp voice calls from one business number inside the CRM.

Can XRover CRM send follow-ups automatically?

Yes. It schedules WhatsApp follow-ups and reminders, sends welcome messages, and reminds customers before renewals or expiry dates.

Can XRover CRM be customised for my business?

Yes. XRover Tech builds and maintains the CRM, so workflows, roles and reports can be adapted to how your team works.
